items.source:
Check if the right-hand side type may be assigned to the left-hand side
type following the Java generics rules.
items.translation: 检查右侧类型是否可以按照 Java 泛型规则赋值给左侧类型。

items.source: Ramnivas Laddad, Juergen Hoeller, Chris Beams, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Ramnivas Laddad, Juergen Hoeller, Chris Beams, Sam Brannen

items.source: Mainly for internal use within the framework.

items.translation: 如果 rhsType 可赋值给 lhsType，则为 true

items.source: rhsType - the value type (right-hand side (RHS) type) that should be assigned to the target type
items.translation: rhsType - 应分配给目标类型的值类型（右侧 (RHS) 类型）
